records.description: Track every oil change, part, and repair across all your vehicles — with an AI that actually knows your year, make, mods, and mileage. Built by a DIY mechanic for DIY mechanics. No fleet manager bloat. Free to start, works on iOS and web.

records.name: The Witness
records.tagline: When a page updates, you understand why.
records.description: Track any public URL. It takes screenshots on a schedule, filters out noise like cookie banners and ad rotations, and uses AI to tell you what actually changed in plain English. Alerts land in Slack, Discord, Telegram, or email. Free for 3 monitors.

records.name: TransformYou
records.tagline: AI-powered fitness app to help visualize your fitness goals
records.description: TransformYou empowers users to visualize their ideal physique. Upload a photo, set your body goals (weight, BMI, body fat, muscle mass), and see a transformed image of yourself. Get personalized diet and exercise plans to achieve your dream look.

records.name: NYT Wordle Solver ~ 3.3 guesses
records.tagline: Solve NYT Wordle in ~3.3 guesses — free, no signup
records.description: Tired of getting stuck on Wordle? Wordle Solver & Help uses a Hybrid Entropy Engine to suggest the mathematically optimal word every turn — averaging just 3.3 guesses, beating even the NYT's own WordleBot (3.8 avg). What makes it different: 🧠 AI-powered suggestions ranked by information entropy ✅ 100% success rate across 12,000+ valid Wordle words ⚡ No signup, no ads, works instantly on mobile & desktop 🎯 Hard mode support, starting word guide & tips 📺 Video tutorial for first-time users

records.name: A-Lift Overnight Vit-A Body Treatment
records.tagline: Facial-grade Vitamin A renewal for your entire body
records.description: Meet A-Lift: High-performance facial tech, redesigned for the body. Most Vitamin A products stop at the jawline, but A-Lift brings firming Bakuchiol and brightening Antioxidants to your entire silhouette. We’re launching a Jumbo Limited Edition offering 45% savings—get double the product for the price of our standard 4oz! It’s the ultimate overnight solution for sagging, crepey skin and uneven tone. Shake, apply, and wake up to a firmer look

records.name: orchagent
records.tagline: Host and run AI agents in the cloud — on demand or always-on
records.description: AI-Agent native cloud infrastructure. Deploy with one command — get scheduling, secrets, run history, and team workspaces out of the box. Run agents on demand or always-on 24/7. Every execution sandboxed. Agents orchestrate other agents, tools, and skills in chains with LLM cost tracking. Fork a template and deploy in minutes. Free tier available

records.name: FloorFlow - Feng Shui Planner
records.tagline: Room planning with feng shui, lighting & design validation
records.description: FloorFlow is a 2D room planner for iOS that validates whether your space actually works, not just whether things fit. Four layers of real-time analysis: • Feng Shui: Command position, chi flow, room balance • Lighting: Four-layer coverage validation • Design Standards: NKBA, OSHA, ADA clearance checks • AI Visualization: Gemini-powered room renders Every issue explained in plain language with a specific fix. One-time purchase. No subscription. No ads.

records.name: Jott
records.tagline: Digital Sticky note style to do list app
records.description: FREE PROMO CODE on request! Jott is a minimalist to-do list app designed for simplicity, featuring a calm interface with checkboxes for tasks and no subscriptions required. Key Features It offers 6 handcrafted themes for customization. The app focuses on core functionality like adding and checking off tasks, avoiding complex features to prevent overwhelming users. Developed as a response to overly complicated to-do apps that prioritize organization over quick task completion

records.name: CalendarLover
records.tagline: Custom calendar tool: US holidays & moon phases.
records.description: CalendarLover is an all-in-one resource for organized living. We provide high-quality, printable calendars that include not just federal holidays, but also specific US state holidays, religious observances, and moon phases. Designed with a minimalist approach, our tool helps users stay organized without the clutter of traditional sites. Perfect for home, office, or academic planning.
